wording.zh-Hans: AI 搭建应用（预览，不写入合同）

wording.en: Install with Docker Compose or Helm; tested upgrades, backup and restore, offline install
wording.zh-Hans: Docker Compose 或 Helm 一键安装，经过验证的升级、备份恢复与离线安装

wording.en: Every tool call by the built-in AI is audited; the AI can never see more than the user can
wording.zh-Hans: 内置 AI 的每次工具调用都有审计，AI 看到的永远不超过用户本人的权限

wording.en: Multi-organization isolation is open source since ObjectStack 17.4; Enterprise licenses and supports it
wording.zh-Hans: 多组织隔离自 ObjectStack 17.4 起开源，企业版提供许可与支持

wording.en: One Enterprise edition: private deployment, priced per AI user, 25 users minimum — contact sales
wording.zh-Hans: 企业版只有一个：私有部署，按 AI 用户数计费，最低 25 人，请联系销售

wording.en: Multi-replica high availability: in development, not promised until it ships
wording.zh-Hans: 多副本高可用：开发中，交付前不承诺
